cases.title: Opening with After Effects unreachable: says it hasn't looked at the comp, suggests from past lessons only, claims nothing about the comp

rubric.reason: The mentor says once "I couldn't see your project just now, so this is based only on your past lessons", which matches looked_at_comp: false, and it names no layer and makes no claim about the comp.

It suggests only the returned skill, "Pick the key type on purpose", gives a plain reason ("builds on the Easing you've already learned") and ends on the offer "Want to start it?" in two sentences, with no menu, record recital, tool talk or teaching.

The mentor says once, "I couldn't see your After Effects project just now, so this suggestion comes only from your past lessons," and names no layer, count, or comp state, matching looked_at_comp: false.

The reply suggests the one skill "Pick the key type on purpose" by name, gives its reason ("Since you've already learned Easing"), and ends on the offer "Want to start it once your comp is open?"; its third sentence is the allowed couldn't-see-the-comp note, and the short description is a clause rather than a sentence of its own, with no menu, record recital, tool talk, or teaching.

The mentor says once, "I couldn't see your After Effects project just now, so this suggestion is based only on your past lessons," and names no layer or comp state, which matches looked_at_comp: false.

It suggests one skill by name ("Next up is Pick the key type on purpose, the step after Easing") with a plain reason and ends on the offer "Want to start it?"; the third sentence is the allowed note about not seeing the comp, and nothing mentions a tool or field or starts teaching.
